integrity: The proof is analytic. The sufficient and converse directions were reconstructed independently, including pointwise stochastic domination of the dyadic counterexample and the nondecreasing information-timestamp condition. No numerical experiment is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Sharpness is universal over bounded-growth age processes with a common stochastic dominator, not a claim that each process with an infinite-log-moment dominator fails. The stochastic-approximation consequence concerns the harmonic delay-control step; all other assumptions of the cited convergence theorems remain in force.
title: The logarithmic moment is the sharp universal threshold for sublinear age of information
